comments.author: vinay-dhawan
comments.body: Please add explicit test coverage for DEFINITE and FULLY PAID booking statuses, including expected document types for each status.
comments.responseComment: Agreed. DEFINITE is exercised by the core-document theory and asserts CBKINV and ATOLCERTIFICATE. FULLY PAID has a dedicated scenario asserting CBKINV, ATOLCERTIFICATE, ITINERARYDOCUMENT, and TRVDOC. I replaced its permanent skip with a runtime-skippable test so the scenario now executes whenever matching storage data is available.
comments.actionSummary: Enabled executable FULLY PAID coverage by changing TC13 from a permanently skipped Fact to a SkippableFact. Retained the explicit per-status document-type assertions and the existing DEFINITE theory case. The human review thread was not resolved.

comments.author: vinay-dhawan
comments.body: These tests are data-dependent. If seed/storage booking data is unavailable, please skip/inconclusive the test instead of failing on assertions, to avoid false negatives in pipeline runs.
comments.responseComment: Agreed. These scenarios depend on holiday bookings selected from environment storage. They now use the repository's skippable-test mechanism and skip only when prerequisite booking data is missing, unavailable, or incomplete; downstream/API responses and document-contract assertions still fail normally.
comments.actionSummary: Converted all storage-backed tests in RetrieveHolidayBookingDocumentDetailsTests to SkippableFact/SkippableTheory and replaced assertion-based prerequisite validation with TestDataPrerequisiteHelper.ValidateHolidayDetailsOrSkip. No human review threads were resolved.
